responsibility: Generated header describing LoongArch ISA-evolution features and their hardware discovery mapping. It declares the cpucfg bit-to-option-mask table, the subset of cpucfg words worth reading, the EVO_* feature enumeration, ISA_HAS_* condition macros on la_target.isa.evolution, and extern arrays for feature masks, builtin macro names, and version numbers, forming the shared interface between cpucfg probing, option state, and feature tests.
same_name_distinction: Unlike loongarch-evolution.cc, this generated header defines the shared interface for ISA-evolution handling—feature enumeration, CPUCFG-to-feature mapping, ISA_HAS_* test macros, and extern declarations—rather than the concrete feature-mask, macro-name, and version tables themselves.
